## 2. Projects - https://anonymousgca.eu/projects

Live websites, Svelte packages and components, university work and developer tooling. Everything here is shipped and open, sorted by most recent activity. Pick a category and dive in: Everything, Websites, Svelte works, University, VS Code. Cards show the kind, tech tags and fact badges (grades, npm, extension); the live websites also offer a preview.

Websites:

- Ristorante Aquazzurra Resort: https://ristoranteaquazzurrasveltekit.netlify.app/. Multilingual restaurant website in Italian, English and German with menu, gallery and contact flow, designed and shipped end to end. Tech: SvelteKit, Paraglide i18n, Static.

Svelte works:
- svelte-tooltip-gca (npm): https://www.npmjs.com/package/svelte-tooltip-gca. Theme-aware tooltip action for Svelte 5 with automatic light/dark themes, native Popover API top-layer rendering and mobile-friendly behavior. Published on npm and used by this site. Tech: Svelte 5, npm package, Action.
- svelte-image-compressor: https://github.com/GABRYCA/svelte-image-compressor. SvelteKit image compressor and converter to WebP built on Sharp, with a minimal API and token authentication. Tech: SvelteKit, Sharp, WebP.
- svelte-image-proxy: https://github.com/GABRYCA/svelte-image-proxy. Image compression service with an API, built with Svelte 5 and SvelteKit. Tech: Svelte 5, API, Service.
- eu.anonymousgca.svelte (this site): https://github.com/GABRYCA/eu.anonymousgca.svelte. This website, built with SvelteKit 3 and Svelte 5 on Bun, statically rendered for Cloudflare Pages. Tech: SvelteKit 3, Svelte 5, Bun.

Melanoma staging app built with Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose Multiplatform, targeting Android and iOS, backed by Firebase Firestore. Mobile programming exam project. Tech: Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose Multiplatform, Firebase.

## 4. Collection (The Collection of Pi) - https://anonymousgca.eu/collection

A collection of single-board computers.

### Raspberry Pi Zero 2W (retired)
Deployment: 25/12/2021. Status: Retired (December 2023). Replaced by Orange Pi Zero 2W 4GB.
Specs: 512MB RAM (limitation), 4-core 64-bit ARM CPU, slow 2.4GHz WiFi (less than 40mbps), Bluetooth 4.2, 1x Micro-USB 2.0, 1x Mini HDMI, 1x Power Micro USB, 1x CSI camera connector, 1x GPIO 40-pin.
History: served as an efficient low-power Linux server for years. Always swapping (killed a 128GB Samsung EVO Plus micro SD, luckily under warranty), slow WiFi, kept freezing and required a reboot. Terminal-only usage.
Usage: Docker containers, background tasks (passive income), experiments and emulators (learned about binfmt and could run AMD64 programs thanks to that), little Apache web server.
Price at time of buy: 23€ including shipping fees.

### Orange Pi Zero 2W 4GB (operational)
Deployment: 01/12/2023. Status: Operational. Bought for the specs and the deal (28$).
Specs: 4GB LPDDR4 RAM, 4-core 64-bit ARM CPU, 2.4/5GHz WiFi 5 handles easily 100mbps, Bluetooth 5.0 BLE, 1x USB-C 2.0, 1x Mini HDMI, 1x Power USB-C, 1x CSI camera connector, 1x GPIO 40-pin.
Initial problems: unclear initial connection setup (an hidden first_run config file in the Ubuntu ISO enabled WiFi automatically after editing), default apt Huawei repositories (changed back to ports.ubuntu.com).
Usage: even more Docker containers, background tasks (passive income), experiments and emulators (still using binfmt to run AMD64 programs), little Apache web server.
Price: about 27€ including shipping fees after change.

## 5. Simulatore Laurea Università (University Grade Simulator) - https://anonymousgca.eu/utility/universita

Calcolatore e simulatore di media ponderata e voto di laurea finale. I dati restano solo sul tuo dispositivo: everything is stored in localStorage on the user's device, no server involved.

Based on the Italian university system, specifically the Università degli Studi dell'Insubria (DiSTA).

How it works:
- Add exams with name, CFU (1 to 30), grade (18 to 30) and lode (only for a grade of 30).
- The exam table lists every exam with CFU, vote, lode and weight (vote × CFU).
- Stats: CFU acquired (out of 180), exams taken, weighted average (out of 30) and lodes (+0.33 bonus each).
- Projection (Voto di Laurea): voto attuale from completed CFU, scenario migliore (all 30 in the remaining exams, with potential lodes) and scenario peggiore (all 18); remaining exams are estimated from the average CFU per exam.

Key facts:
- Weighted average (media ponderata) per the Italian system (Insubria's rules).
- "Lode" counts as a normal 30 but adds 0.33 bonus points to the final grade, regardless of exam CFU weight.
- Base score: (Media Ponderata × 110) ÷ 30.
- Lode bonus: number of lodes × 0.33 points.
- Maximum: 110 e lode (if base is at least 110).
- Total CFU: 180.

Disclaimer (as shown): "I calcoli e le proiezioni mostrate sono puramente indicativi e possono contenere errori. Non si assumono responsabilità per eventuali inesattezze o differenze rispetto ai calcoli ufficiali dell'ateneo. Nessun genere di informazione sui dati inseriti viene salvata o condivisa, lo strumento funziona totalmente sul dispositivo dell'utente finale."

## 6. ADE - Architettura degli Elaboratori (Bit Calculator) - https://anonymousgca.eu/utility/ade

Calcolatori per ADE: bit per la memoria e per la cache, conversione bit e byte, potenze di 2, indirizzamenti di memoria e conversioni binario/decimale. Bit, memory and cache calculators for the computer architecture course (Architettura degli Elaboratori, Insubria). All calculations run entirely in the browser.

Tools included (eight calculators):
- Bit Memoria/Cache: how many bits an address needs for a power-of-two quantity (2, 4, 8, 16... 512) expressed in Byte, KB, MB or GB.
- Convertitore Bit a Byte: bits to bytes (multiples of 8, usually 16, 32, 64...) with the addressing bits (powers of two).
- Potenza di 2: computes 2 to the given exponent.
- Memoria Totale: total bits for a memory quantity (power of two) in the chosen scale (Byte/KB/MB/GB).
- Dimensione Blocco/offset: block size in bits from words and bits per word (word bits + offset bits, bits per word must be a multiple of 8).
- Dimensione Memoria Cache: cache size in bits from the cache quantity (power of two) and scale.
- Binario a Decimale and Decimale a Binario converters; input is validated (binary: only 0 and 1; decimal: digits only) with a friendly Italian message on invalid values, and conversions run through BigInt so long inputs stay exact.

---

## 7. Energia (Electricity Prices) - https://anonymousgca.eu/utility/energy

Grafico in tempo reale dei prezzi dell'elettricità in Italia: costo orario "day-ahead" della componente elettrica, tramite il Mercato del Giorno Prima (MGP). All data handling is client-side (static-site friendly).

Features:
- Custom zero-dependency SVG chart of the 24 hourly prices with day tabs (Ieri/Oggi/Domani as available), hover/touch tooltip, and keyboard exploration (slider role, arrow keys); an accessible per-hour table mirrors the chart.
- Unit toggle: €/MWh and c€/kWh.
- Cheapest 3-hour band, now marker, min/max hour dots and min/max badges in the table.
- Time ranges: "3 gg" hourly view with day tabs, "7 gg" and "30 gg" daily-mean trend charts with period stats (period average, cheapest and priciest day, coverage) and a per-day table, "12 mesi" monthly means with per-month table.
- "Quanto mi costa?" estimator: consumption in kWh times the reference price (media del giorno/ora più economica/ora più cara/ora corrente; over a range the period or month equivalents). It estimates the energy-only cost (senza oneri, IVA e quota fissa); it is not a bill.
- Data chain: real day-ahead history (about 400 days) baked at build time into a same-origin JSON file, so long views always have true data; recent days refresh live through public CORS proxies; auto-refresh every 15 minutes (pauses in background tabs, can be turned off). An honest badge states the source of the current view: Live, proxy, Cache (with an honest note) or Demo when the network never answered.
- Sources and attribution: GME (Gestore dei Mercati Energetici, mercatoelettrico.org) for the official PUN; zona Nord prices via energy-charts.info / Fraunhofer ISE (CC BY 4.0, dati Bundesnetzagentur | SMARD.de). Zone Nord is used honestly as a PUN proxy; the exact PUN comes from GME.
- Disclaimer (as shown): "Valori a scopo informativo (materia energia, IVA e oneri esclusi), non costituiscono la bolletta."

---

## 8. Neon Grove (Pixel RPG) - https://anonymousgca.eu/utility/game

A tiny web-RPG adventure in three levels by AnonymousGCA: Lv.1 Neon Grove, Lv.2 Murk Marsh and Lv.3 Null Core. Wander the grove, haggle in the marsh, and face the Null King in the Core. Collect shards and stardust, level up, and beat the boss that carries the final shard. Progress autosaves in your browser until you erase it.

Friendly NPCs: Owlbit, Fox.exe, Marrow and Sage Root. Marrow's shop sells Glow Potions and heartfruit; the marsh hides a brass key and a locked chest; the core is a lava fortress guarded by the Null King boss.

How to play:
- Start with Space, Enter, or the big Action button, or Continue your saved run.
- Walk with WASD / arrow keys, or the on-screen D-pad on mobile.
- Talk and loot: face Owlbit, Marrow, chests, keys, or shards, then press Action. Coins, hearts, and keys pop on touch.
- Battle when you bump a foe: Attack, drink a Glow Potion, or Flee (the Null King won't let you).
- Grow: bonking foes earns XP and stardust. Level up for +1 max HP; spend stardust at Marrow's shop.
- Win: clear Lv.1 Grove (3 shards), Lv.2 Marsh (4 shards + locked chest), then Lv.3 Core, where the boss holds the 5th shard.
- Saves persist in localStorage across visits; erase them only with the Erase button.

## 9. Insubria (commute schedules) - https://anonymousgca.eu/insubria

Public transport commutes from Intra/Laveno (Lake Maggiore) to the University of Insubria campus in Varese. The index page asks to pick a day ("Scegli un giorno"). Each weekday page lists the ferry (traghetto, Intra to Laveno), train (Trenord, Laveno Mombello Lago to Varese Nord) and bus (Linea C/RS, Morosini FS/FNM to Monte Generoso, 71 ASL) legs with departure and arrival times, duration and wait between legs, plus normale/anticipatario alternatives.

- Lunedì (Monday): https://anonymousgca.eu/insubria/lunedi
- Martedì (Tuesday): https://anonymousgca.eu/insubria/martedi
- Mercoledì (Wednesday): https://anonymousgca.eu/insubria/mercoledi
- Giovedì (Thursday): https://anonymousgca.eu/insubria/giovedi
- Venerdì (Friday): https://anonymousgca.eu/insubria/venerdi

Official timetables linked on every day page: the Insubria bus line PDF (uninsubria.it), CTPi Linea C and Linea E, Trenitalia trains and Navigazione Laghi (Lake Maggiore boats).
